positioning: I like the beginning of things. New ideas. New technologies. New behaviors. New possibilities.

I'm a Design & AI Executive and Venture Builder working across product, design, business and emerging technology. I explore opportunities before the answers are obvious — turning ideas into concepts, prototypes, products, ventures and experiences that people can actually react to.
My strength is 0→1: seeing possibilities, connecting things that don't normally belong together, and creating enough clarity and momentum for a team to take the idea forward.
I work through venture building, executive advisory, fractional leadership and hands-on experimentation between New York, Japan, and wherever the interesting problems are.
